newsitem.title: USA: SIMS says to open new plant in Florida.
newsitem.headline: SIMS says to open new plant in Florida.

text.p: Sims Communications Inc said Wednesday it plans to open a new assembly plant in Tampa, Florida.
A spokesman said it will cost Sims about $40,000 to $50,000 to set up the plant, which will be used predominantly by recent Sims acquisition New View Technologies.
The plant may also be used for existing Sims products, the company said. Sims, a provider of telecommunications services and products, said it expects the plant will be operational within 45 days.
